# Bricolage Grotesque — local Latin subset

Mathieu Triay / The Bricolage Grotesque Project Authors. SIL Open Font License 1.1,
bundled beside this file. Downloaded 2026-10-18 from Google Fonts' Latin WOFF2
subset; the browser makes no runtime font request outside Atelier.

- Upstream: https://github.com/ateliertriay/bricolage
- Google Fonts source snapshot: 84745e5b96261ae5f8c6c856e262fe78d1d6efdd
- Metadata: https://github.com/google/fonts/blob/main/ofl/bricolagegrotesque/METADATA.pb
- Font: https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/bricolagegrotesque/v9/3y996as8bTXq_nANBjzKo3IeZx8z6up5L-iNGQ.woff2
- Request: `Bricolage Grotesque:opsz,wdth,wght@12..96,75..100,200..800`
- Contains Google's Latin subset (basic Latin, Western accented Latin, punctuation
  and common symbols); other scripts fall back to the local control font.

The source is already subsetted by Google Fonts; no build-time font tool or
additional runtime dependency is required. SHA-256 is recorded below.
SHA-256: `a756882d8a7802ebd4663b4544a62ebedafc7227c1c159ab95eea61393af3f8e`
